author: @AliceQuitter
text:
This is truly one of the comps of all time, but as a Pandia enjoyer, it makes me very happy. Pandia-Nautila-Alva-Faint carried me through Faded Legacy, so this kind of feels like looking at a photo of my childhood home while knowing it was demolished years ago. What if we used Caecus instead of Tawil for better counter gen? (That burst probably would have done more than 1.4M damage if not for Cerberus's shieldslop mechanics, though.)

The thing about standard Awakeners is that, on a long enough timeline, you'll eventually +12 them all just by getting spooked. I threw my heavily-invested +6 Pandia back in the pool the last time they passed out resets, but she's already at +2 again just from pulling for G-Lotan.
